channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Thurles to host All-Ireland camogie club final replay
item.description: FBD Semple Stadium will host the All-Ireland club senior camogie championship final replay between Athenry and St Finbarr's on Saturday, January 3.

item.title: Kerry legend O'Mahony returns to his roots
item.description: Aidan O'Mahony will take charge of his home club Rathmore in 2026.

item.title: 'We got a bit of momentum and stayed going'
item.description: Ballygunner boss Jason Ryan was delighted with his side's second half performance after they saw off St Martin's to qualify for only their second-ever All-Ireland club SHC final.

item.title: All-Ireland club final fixture details confirmed
item.description: The GAA has announced the times and dates for the All-Ireland club football and hurling finals in Croke Park next month.

item.title: "It'll probably be eating at them, the way they performed"
item.description: Slaughtneil manager Paul McCormack says his side's performance against Loughrea in Sunday's All-Ireland club SHC semi-final was "nowhere near" the level it needed to be to get the win.

item.title: "There was very, very little in it" - Coen on Killeen red card
item.description: Loughrea full-back Johnny Coen felt the decision to send off team mate Cullen Killeen in the latter stages of Sunday's All-Ireland club senior hurling championship final was a harsh one.

item.title: Former Republic of Ireland international O'Kane takes over Banagher
item.description: Former Republic of Ireland international Eunan O'Kane has been appointed as Derry club Banagher's new senior football manager for the 2026 season.

item.title: "Heading to Croke Park is stuff we dreamed of" - Ryan
item.description: Upperchurch-Drombane captain Keith Ryan described the "unreal" feeling after his club booked their place into the All-Ireland intermediate hurling championship final at the weekend.

item.title: Cowley takes Arva reins
item.description: Former Meath minor football manager Joe Cowley has taken over Cavan senior side Arva for the 2026 season.

item.title: Blow for Wexford as O'Connor to miss most of 2026 season
item.description: Wexford manager Keith Rossiter looks set to be without ace attacker Rory O'Connor for the majority of the 2026 season.
